// Finding identifies a refused normalization operation or schema boundary.
type Finding struct {
	Pointer string `json:"pointer"`
	Rule    string `json:"rule"`
	Detail  string `json:"detail"`
}

// Refused contains source-located findings and never a partial successful value.
type Refused []Finding

func (r Refused) Error() string { value, _ := json.Marshal(r); return string(value) }
func refusal(at, rule, detail string) error {
	return Refused{{Pointer: at, Rule: rule, Detail: detail}}
}
func pointer(at, key string) string {
	return at + "/" + strings.ReplaceAll(strings.ReplaceAll(key, "~", "~0"), "/", "~1")
}

type scope struct {
	input, item any
	index       int64
	bound       bool
}
type expression func(scope, string) (any, error)
type condition func(scope, string) (bool, error)
type absent struct{}

var missing = absent{}

func isMissing(value any) bool { _, ok := value.(absent); return ok }

type member struct {
	name  string
	value expression
}
type stage struct {
	input, output int
	requires      []condition
	value         expression
}
type schemaSource struct{ path string }

//go:embed schemas/*.schema.json
var schemaFiles embed.FS

// Normalizer holds the compiled, source-pinned validators for this generated recipe.
type Normalizer struct{ validators []*jsonschema.Schema }

// New constructs offline validators. No schema network loader is installed.
func New() (*Normalizer, error) {
	compiler := jsonschema.NewCompiler()
	compiler.DefaultDraft(jsonschema.Draft2020)
	ids := make([]string, len(rootSources))
	for i, source := range rootSources {
		data, err := schemaFiles.ReadFile(source.path)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, refusal("/roots", "target_schema", "embedded schema is unavailable")
		}
		document, err := jsonschema.UnmarshalJSON(bytes.NewReader(data))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, refusal("/roots", "target_schema", "embedded schema is invalid")
		}
		object, ok := document.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			return nil, refusal("/roots", "target_schema", "embedded schema is not an identified document")
		}
		id, ok := object["$id"].(string)
		if !ok {
			return nil, refusal("/roots", "target_schema", "embedded schema has no identity")
		}
		if err := compiler.AddResource(id, document); err != nil {
			return nil, refusal("/roots", "target_schema", "embedded schema cannot be registered")
		}
		ids[i] = id
	}
	normalizer := &Normalizer{validators: make([]*jsonschema.Schema, len(ids))}
	for i, id := range ids {
		schema, err := compiler.Compile(id)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, refusal("/roots", "target_schema", "embedded schema cannot be compiled")
		}
		normalizer.validators[i] = schema
	}
	return normalizer, nil
}

// Normalize decodes one JSON value and returns only a fully validated final result.
func (n *Normalizer) Normalize(branch string, data []byte) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	current, err := parseInput(data, numberPaths[branch], capturePaths[branch], positionalPolicies[branch])
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	pipeline, ok := branches[branch]
	if !ok {
		return nil, refusal("/branches", "unknown_dispatch", "external discriminator has no declared branch")
	}
	for i, stage := range pipeline {
		at := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d", pointer("/branches", branch), i)
		if err := n.validate(stage.input, current, at+"/input"); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		context := scope{input: current}
		for index, test := range stage.requires {
			at := fmt.Sprintf("%s/requires/%d", at, index)
			ok, err := test(context, at)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if !ok {
				return nil, refusal(at, "requirement_failed", "stage requirement is false")
			}
		}
		value, err := stage.value(context, at+"/value")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if isMissing(value) {
			return nil, refusal(at, "missing_output", "stage output is absent")
		}
		if err := n.validate(stage.output, value, at+"/output"); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		current = value
	}
	result, err := json.Marshal(wireValue(current))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, refusal("/output", "target_json", "complete result cannot be serialized")
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (n *Normalizer) validate(root int, value any, at string) error {
	if root < 0 || root >= len(n.validators) {
		return refusal(at, "target_root", "embedded stage root is absent")
	}
	err := n.validators[root].Validate(value)
	if err == nil {
		return nil
	}
	var validation *jsonschema.ValidationError
	if !errors.As(err, &validation) {
		return refusal(at, "schema_validation", "value does not satisfy the selected stage contract")
	}
	found := Refused{}
	var collect func(*jsonschema.ValidationError)
	collect = func(err *jsonschema.ValidationError) {
		switch err.ErrorKind.(type) {
		case *kind.Schema, *kind.Group, *kind.Reference, *kind.AllOf:
			for _, child := range err.Causes {
				collect(child)
			}
			return
		}
		location := at
		for _, part := range err.InstanceLocation {
			location = pointer(location, part)
		}
		count := 1
		if required, ok := err.ErrorKind.(*kind.Required); ok {
			count = len(required.Missing)
		}
		for i := 0; i < count; i++ {
			found = append(found, Finding{Pointer: location, Rule: "schema_validation", Detail: "value does not satisfy the selected stage contract"})
		}
	}
	collect(validation)
	sort.SliceStable(found, func(i, j int) bool { return found[i].Pointer < found[j].Pointer })
	return found
}

func wireValue(value any) any {
	switch value := value.(type) {
	case float64:
		text := strconv.FormatFloat(value, 'g', -1, 64)
		if !strings.ContainsAny(text, ".eE") {
			text += ".0"
		}
		return json.Number(text)
	case []any:
		out := make([]any, len(value))
		for i, item := range value {
			out[i] = wireValue(item)
		}
		return out
	case map[string]any:
		out := make(map[string]any, len(value))
		for key, item := range value {
			out[key] = wireValue(item)
		}
		return out
	default:
		return value
	}
}

func present(value expression, context scope, at string) (any, error) {
	result, err := value(context, at)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if isMissing(result) {
		return nil, refusal(at, "missing_value", "required expression value is absent")
	}
	return result, nil
}
func integer(value any, at string) (int64, error) {
	result, ok := value.(int64)
	if !ok {
		return 0, refusal(at, "integer_representation", "operation requires an exact integral token representable as signed 64-bit")
	}
	return result, nil
}
func stringValue(value expression, context scope, at string) (string, error) {
	result, err := present(value, context, at)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	text, ok := result.(string)
	if !ok {
		return "", refusal(at, "string_value", "operation requires a string")
	}
	return text, nil
}
func array(value any, at string) ([]any, error) {
	result, ok := value.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil, refusal(at, "collection_value", "operation requires a list")
	}
	return result, nil
}
